items.title: Interview #105 Vic Chynoweth, CEO of Tempo
items.summary: Vic Chynoweth, CEO of Tempo, breaks down why companies keep raising AI budgets they cannot tie to a return, and why 2027 budget planning is when CFOs finally say stop. He explains why lines of code and hours saved measure almost nothing once code is commoditized, how linking LLM spend to the code repository and the ticketing system let one company cut annualized AI spend from $3 million to $1 million with no loss of throughput, and why an expensive model should have to earn its place. Vic also dives into strategic drift, where AI speeds up the work but not the link between strategy and that work, and why shadow AI shows up first in credit card spend. Finally, he shares why delivery dates now move earlier instead of later, and why the winners will be the companies that know their market well enough to point fast teams of people and agents in the right direction.
